summary: Iter16 — Verified 3 new world-class features (Customer Moments, WhatsApp Co-pilot, Voice Notes) + segments/filters regression. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass against live preview URL with manager bearer auth. Customer Moments CRUD validated (list/create/delete + all 7 valid types + 400 on bad type + GET-after-POST persistence). WhatsApp Co-pilot draft-message tested across all 6 intents (checkin, winback, birthday, new_arrivals, thank_you, custom) — Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns exactly 3 variants each with {label, text}. Voice-note endpoint accepts WAV multipart; Whisper transcribed a 0.2s silence WAV successfully (200 with note_id, source='voice', tags{interests,size_notes,sentiment,follow_up}). /api/segments/filters returns 200 (None-sort crash fix confirmed). Frontend: Moments-card under Notes tab works end-to-end (add anniversary moment → appears in moments-list → delete via moment-delete-{id} succeeds). voice-record-button visible & toggles state (mic perm unavailable in headless — gracefully handled per spec). Co-pilot in Send message dialog renders 3 variants (VIP Appreciation, Brand Mix, Soft Personal) and 'Use this' loads variant into message body.

issues: Moments-card lives only under the Notes tab — discoverability could be improved (e.g., a small Moments badge in tab label when count>0 or moving the card above tabs). Cosmetic; not a regression.

verified_acceptance_criteria: POST /api/customers/{id}/moments with valid {type, date, title, recurring_annual, remind_days_before} → 200, returns full doc with moment_id; GET re-confirms persistence.
POST /api/customers/{id}/moments with invalid type 'not_a_real_event' → 400 with detail starting 'Invalid type'.
All 7 MOMENT_TYPES (birthday, anniversary, graduation, wedding, baby, promotion, custom) accepted with 200.
DELETE /api/customers/{id}/moments/{moment_id} → 200 {ok:true}; subsequent GET no longer contains the moment.
POST /api/customers/{id}/draft-message {intent:'checkin', tone:'warm'} → 200 with {variants:[3], intent:'checkin', tone:'warm'}; each variant has {label, text}.
Intents parametrized: winback / birthday / new_arrivals / thank_you all return 200 with 3 variants.
Intent 'custom' with custom_prompt returns 200 with variants honouring brief.

POST /api/customers/{id}/voice-note with multipart 0.2s WAV → 200 with {note_id, source:'voice', tags:{interests,size_notes,sentiment,follow_up}, body}. Whisper transcribed silence as empty string (acceptable per spec). 502 path also acceptable; in this run got 200.
GET /api/segments/filters → 200 with {rfm_tiers:[...], cities:[...]}; None-sort crash regression fixed.
Frontend: /customers/3846911099035 loads as manager; clicking 'Notes' tab reveals moments-card with moment-type, moment-date, moment-title, moment-save inputs.
Frontend: Adding a moment via UI (anniversary / 1995-08-21 / TEST_UI_Anniv) appends to moments-list; subsequent click on moment-delete-{id} removes it (count 0→1→0 verified).
Frontend: voice-record-button has correct data-testid, is visible, and click is gracefully handled in headless (mic permission denied path).

Frontend: 'Send message' opens dialog containing copilot-section; clicking 'Draft 3 options' (draft-go) renders draft-variants with 3 draft-variant-{i} buttons; clicking draft-variant-0 loads its text into the message textarea.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2827 lines — refactor by moving Moments / Co-pilot / Voice-note routers into separate modules (e.g., moments.py, copilot.py, voice.py) consistent with the training.py extraction pattern from iter14.
voice_note endpoint uses synchronous `with open(tf.name,'rb')` inside an async handler; for short clips this is fine, but for production should use aiofiles or stream upload directly to Whisper.

draft-message intent_prompts: 'custom' branch uses f-string with body.custom_prompt at dict literal creation time — works, but the dict is rebuilt per request (no perf issue). Consider validating intent against a known set and warning on unknown rather than silently defaulting to 'checkin'.

Moments scheduler `_run_moments_scheduler` parses `m['date']` with [-10:] slice — fragile if a future client sends date without year (e.g., 'MM-DD'). Current MomentBody allows that but the strptime would fail and silently skip via the try/except. Acceptable for v1, document.
CustomerProfile.jsx is 1494 lines — split moments-card, voice-note section, and Co-pilot dialog into sub-components.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (moments add/delete, copilot 3-variant flow, voice button toggle all verified)

seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up moments under TEST_ prefix. No persistent test data left over.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter16_new_features.py -v`. Note moments-card sits under the 'Notes' Tab in /app/frontend/src/pages/CustomerProfile.jsx (line 648 TabsContent value='notes'), NOT at top of page — Playwright must click the Notes tab first. Co-pilot section is mounted inside the Send-message Dialog (line 1178 onwards), so action-send-message must be clicked first. Voice-record button click in headless gracefully toasts 'Mic permission denied or unsupported' and stays in initial state — that is correct behaviour and not a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found this iteration. All 3 new features (Moments, WhatsApp Co-pilot, Voice Notes) work end-to-end; the previously reported segments/filters None-sort crash is confirmed fixed (server.py lines 2372-2373 use `[t for t in tiers if t]` and `[c for c in cities if c]` filters before sorted()).
